reader.requirement: At --std 85 each Format 1 qualifier of a data-name must be a group superordinate to it or (outermost) the file-name/cd-name of its FD/SD/CD, each qualifier of a condition-name must be its conditional variable or a group/file over it, and the qualifiers must be written innermost first; any other qualifier, order or a file-name not outermost must be refused.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel >= 2002: a data-description-clause operand (OCCURS DEPENDING ON, KEY, RENAMES) takes the groups above its subject as implicit qualifiers; below 2002 the whole scope's candidates are counted, so only explicit qualification makes the operand unique (read by EntryClauseCandidates / RegionClauseCandidates)

reader.edition-search: grep of DataBinder.cs, NameResolution.cs, ReferenceResolver.cs, SymbolTable.cs, ConditionBinder.cs for CobolVersion|EditionContext|ConstructRegistry|DialectBehavior|Edition.(DialectLevel|Edition|Year|Removed): the procedure-division qualified lookup (QualifiedCandidates -> QualifierChainMatchesFrom -> QualifierWalk, ConditionQualifierChainMatches) has no edition test; only Edition.At (cursor) and Edition.Permissive (SR1's --permissive disposition). The per-edition reserved-word gate (Frontend/Parsing/ReservationGateRewriter) decides what is a user-defined word on every path; it is not specific to qualification and no gated word was used.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for the qualifier hierarchy and order; the clause-operand arm (implicit qualifiers from 2002) only changes which candidates an unqualified clause operand sees
reader.witnesses-cover: part: witnesses exercise legal ordered chains of data-names and condition-names, a file qualifier for a condition-name, and report-group qualification; not exercised: refusal of out-of-order chains, non-superordinate or sibling qualifiers, a file-name not outermost, a cd-name qualifier

reader.notes: QualifierWalk consumes qualifiers inner to outer over the item's ancestors (the conditional variable first for a condition-name) and lets only the outermost leftover be the FD/SD file or CD; every refusal probe drew COBOL1639 and every legal chain resolved. No edition test on this path apart from the clause-operand implicit-qualifier arm.

refuter.evidence: I sent the refusals the reader did not try to r4neg at 85. Each drew COBOL1639: A OF RN, where RN is a 66 RENAMES item and so no group superordinate to A (line 31); A OF F1, a file-name qualifying a WORKING-STORAGE item (33); Y OF F2, the wrong file (35); A OF RP, a report-name qualifying a non-report item (37); X OF RP OF R1, a report-name that is not outermost (41). GENERATE DT OF F1 drew COBOL1757. In r12recneg, X OF F1 with X in both records of F1 was refused as ambiguous (2 declarations), and RA OF RA and X OF RB OF RA were refused. Class c: r13cdc shows a condition-name under a CD qualified by its cd-name, a Format 1 form only 85 has (the 2023 qualified-condition-name allows only a file-name outermost). The compiler accepts it and evaluates it correctly: 'C1 F C2 F C3 T C4 T C5 T'. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 SRL2.4 ... the text is in SRL2.4'.
